integrity: Analytical proof and a standalone finite checker are embedded. The numerical and finite tests are not a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Sharp constant and complete equality classification are established only for n>=13. Strict enhancement, not exact constants, is proved for 5<=n<=12. Priority in unindexed historical Nikol'skii tables has not been ruled out. No independent audit.
title: Sharp sixth moments, phase rigidity, and the exact resonance threshold for two dihedral characters
